actions.action: Inspect brown speckles on pot rim
Finger test soil moisture 2-3 inches deep
Slide plant out and inspect roots if soil is wet
Check pot for drainage hole and standing water in saucer
If rot, trim mushy roots with clean scissors
If rot, repot in fresh well-draining soil in pot with drainage hole
If soil dry, water thoroughly until it drains and empty saucer
Move plant away from cold windows and drafts

reason: The answer presents underwatering and overwatering as equally likely, which makes the diagnosis partial; the fix of watering thoroughly until it drains is offered only as one conditional branch, so the advice is partial, and its soil-check safeguard prevents the overwatering advice from being harmful.
